title: Bellerophon's deadly commission
intro: Anteia's false accusation sends Bellerophon to Lycia carrying his own death warrant.

notes.text: σκῆπτρον, sceptre; δαμάζω, subdue: 3sg aor, epic -σσ-. Zeus subjected the Argives to Proetus' rule.
ἐπιμαίνομαι, be madly in love with: 3sg aor mid + dat τῷ, Bellerophon.
κρυπτάδιος, secret; φιλότης, sexual intimacy; μίγνυμι epic 2aor pass inf, lie with / unite.
φρονέω pres ptc acc sg with Bellerophon; “with honourable intentions.”
ψεύδομαι, lie: aor mid ptc; βασιλεύς, king: epic acc sg βασιλῆα.
θνῄσκω perf opt 2sg, wish “may you die”; κατακτείνω 2sg aor imperative κάκτανε (κατ-κτα- assimilation). “Die—or kill him.”
ἐθέλω pres ptc dat fem sg, with μοι implied; “against my will,” the false allegation.
λαμβάνω unaugmented 3sg 2aor; anger seized him. οἷον, “such a thing [as] he heard,” reacting to the report.
κτείνω aor inf; ἀλεείνω, avoid: impf; σεβάζομαι, feel awe / scruple: 3sg aor mid. He avoids direct murder.
Λυκίην + directional -δε, to Lycia. πόρω, give / furnish: unaugmented 3sg 2aor.
σήματα, signs / tokens; λυγρός, deadly / grievous; θυμοφθόρος, life-destroying. The tablet encodes instructions to kill its bearer.
γράφω, inscribe: aor ptc; πίναξ, tablet: dat sg; πτυκτός, folded. A rare Homeric reference to a written message.
δείκνυμι aor inf, show; ἄνωγα 3sg past indicative, not an inf despite -ειν.
His father-in-law; ἀπόλλυμι 3sg 2aor mid opt, purpose “so [Bellerophon] might die.”
ἄμυμων, excellent; πομπή, escort / guidance: dat sg; under the gods' safe guidance.
ἱκνέομαι / ἵκω, reach: unaugmented 3sg aor; ῥέω pres ptc acc sg with Xanthus, the Lycian river here.
προφρονέως, warmly / willingly; τίω, honour: unaugmented 3sg impf.
ἐννῆμαρ, for nine days; ξενίζω, entertain as guest: 3sg aor, epic -σσ-.
ἱερεύω, sacrifice: 3sg aor; rosy-fingered Dawn; δεκάτη, the tenth [dawn / day].
ἐρεείνω, question: impf; αἰτέω, ask for: 3sg impf, uncontracted; εἶδον 2aor mid inf, see.
γαμβρός, son-in-law here; παρά + gen, from Proetus. φέρω 3sg pres mid opt in indirect question: what message he was bringing.
παραδέχομαι, receive: 3sg aor mid.
ἀμαιμάκετος, irresistible / terrible: acc fem sg with Chimaera; πέφνω epic reduplicated aor inf, slay.
“Of divine stock”; γένος neuter predicate / acc of respect, contrasting with human origin.
In front … behind … in the middle. δράκων, serpent; χίμαιρα, she-goat, explaining the monster's name.
ἀποπνέω, breathe out: pres ptc nom fem sg; αἴθω, burn: pres mid ptc gen sg with fire.
καταπέφνω, kill: reduplicated 3sg 2aor; πιθέω, obey / trust: aor ptc; τέρας dat pl τεράεσσι, divine signs.
μάχομαι 3sg aor mid, epic -σσ-; κυδάλιμος, glorious; the Solymi are his next opponents.
κάρτιστος = κράτιστος, hardest / strongest; δύω root aor inf -μεναι, enter. “The hardest battle he ever entered.”
ἀντιάνειρα, a match for men / opposed to men: acc fem pl, Amazons' epithet; the first sense is Murray's rendering.
